item.title: Striking New York City nurses hold day of action to protest ICE
item.description: It's day 18 of the New York City nurses' strike and while there is still no end in sight, the nurses are holding a day of action to protest ICE.

item.title: 'Send Help' new featurette: Behind the blood and chaos on Sam Raimi's set
item.description: What does it take to survive a Sam Raimi set? "Send Help" stars Rachel McAdams and Dylan O'Brien spill on blood, stunts, and wild scenes in a new featurette. Watch "Send Help" in theaters this Friday January 30.

item.title: NYPD officer who rescued choking child last month saves another baby
item.description: Last month, Officer Cerpa saved a choking 1-year-old girl and now weeks later, he's done it again, saving a 2-year-old boy.

item.title: Boy Scout troop helps homebound seniors in Oakland, New Jersey clear snow-covered driveways
item.description: After recent snowstorms, several senior residents in Oakland, New Jersey remain stuck at home, unable to safely leave because heavy snow is still blocking their driveways.

item.title: Former Illinois deputy sentenced to 20 years in prison for killing Sonya Massey
item.description: A former Illinois sheriff's deputy was sentenced to 20 years in prison for fatally shooting Sonya Massey, who had dialed 911 to report a possible prowler outside her Springfield home.

item.title: Democrats, White House strike spending deal that would avert government shutdown
item.description: Senate Democrats said Thursday they have struck an agreement to move forward with a package of bills to avert a partial government shutdown.
